name: Mandatory Reconsideration
description: Formal review of a DWP benefit decision. Must be requested before you can appeal to a tribunal. Apply within 1 month of the decision letter.
eligibility_summary: If you disagree with a DWP decision on Universal Credit, JSA, ESA, PIP, or other benefits, you must request a Mandatory Reconsideration before you can appeal to a tribunal. Must be requested within 1 month of the decision letter.
